basis: The six core semantic checks were recorded in each raw control/*-graded.json semantic_review.must_check before independent grading. This binding gives those pre-existing checks stable arm-qualified IDs. Observability differences and missing human-time measurements are reported separately, not silently converted into successes.
structural_checks: Both arms received identical source facts and explicit dependencies, with equal task/tool budgets.
Participants actually read and edited isolated stores; no evaluator applied their proposed writes later.
All actual raw, input, after-store, original-grade and comparison artifacts are hash-bound.
Measured calls, tokens, walltime and diff bytes match raw receipts.
Original negative or ambiguous observations and unmeasured human costs remain explicit.
not_required_for_success: Invented human review or correction duration
limits: One pair; whole-pass agent walltime only. Independent grader is not representation-blinded and belongs to the tool-building team. Raw prose labels remain ambiguous and were not repaired.
